This guide shows a minimal call to `run_power_simulation()`.

## Run a simulation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(scdbayes)
power <- run_power_simulation(
  n_sims = 50,
  n_cases = 3,
  n_phase_a = 5,
  n_phase_b = 5,
  effect_sizes = c(0, 0.5, 1),
  seed = 2026
)
power
```

This small example illustrates the call. Simulation runs require Stan and
can take substantial time because they fit Bayesian models.

## Review results

The result contains a row per effect size with power estimates and simulation
diagnostics. Check diagnostics before interpreting estimates. See
`?run_power_simulation` for arguments.
